title: Three Men One Heart- Thumbs UP Spot
summary: A clean 35-second official-channel promotional voiceover for Thumbs Up America. “Three men, one heart” and “any means necessary” introduce a mission to connect with the unconditional love of people in the United States, pursue love/happiness/freedom, travel by trains, boats and automobiles, and more importantly ride the metaphorical vibrations of human kindness. The listener is invited out of the head and into ‘our hearts’ to find goodness in America. Every idealistic phrase remains. It is promotional curation rather than proof that the series found all national goodness; “any means necessary” is hyperbole, transport modes supply no unsafe/illegal instructions, vibrations/head/heart are metaphor, and “other side” is a show sign-off. The narrator is not publisher-labeled; zero named turns ship.

speaker_policy.reason: The official David Choe channel establishes work provenance but captions provide no narrator credit/prefix. Do not assume David Choe or any of the three travelers voices the spot without audiovisual/credit evidence. Publish zero named turns.
